scenes.name: AK1200

models.definition:
BLOB

num_charges                   5       ; can go up to 32 (for now)
coloration                    1       ; 0 = use object color from ashex file or UI, 1 = use per-vertex colors
texturing                     1 
threshold                     0.20    ; range of 0.1 ... 0.2
min_mag                       0.30    ; size of blobs - just experiment to get the right sizes.  If blobs are too big, they will get clipped at the square (1x1x1) bounding box.
max_mag                       0.45
audio_control_signal_decay    0.750    ; controls the amount of time until complete decay of audio signal (when there's a spike in a certain band frequency, and the blobs react).
texture_mode                  ENV2    ; ENV = normal (slow) environment mapping,
                                      ;  ENV2 = fast env. mapping (skips arcsin; often looks better);
                                      ;   PROJECTION = projection (decal) mapping directly onto x/y plane.
texture_scale                 1.0 1.0 1.0


; COLORS
;
; if 'coloration' is 0, the object is rendered in only one color,
;   which is the base color from the ASHEX file (or later, the UI).
; if 'coloration' is 1, then each node in the blob is colored individually
;   and the colors are blended between blobs.  The color of each node is
;   equal to the base color of the entire blob, plus some +/- deviation.
;   For example, if the base object is 0.7 red, and the deviation for
;   red is 0.2, then each node's red component will be a random number
;   from 0.5 to 0.9.

max_color_dev_r       0.10
max_color_dev_g       0.15
max_color_dev_b       0.15
max_color_dev_a       0.0

; MOVEMENT

orbit_silent_min_speed                0.010 0.010 0.010 ; base rotational speed of node orbits, in revs. per frame, in x, y, and z dimensions, when music is silent.
orbit_silent_max_speed                0.050 0.050 0.050 ; 
orbit_loud_extra_speed                0.50              ; ADDITIONAL rotational speed (in rpf) of nodes in rev. per second, when music 'hits'
orbit_max_dist_from_center            0.20 0.20 0.20    ; max. distance of any node from the center of the 1x1x1 volume, in x/y/z dimensions.
orbit_loud_extra_dist_from_center     0.00 0.00 0.00    ; addl. distance from center that is possible when the music hits.  The nodes will suddenly jump outward (in x/y/z) by this extra amount, then slowly come back in.




; other general notes
; 
; 1. The entire blob is in a 1x1x1 cube going from (0,0,0) to (1,1,1).
;      You should ensure that it never extends beyond this range
;      or it will have holes in it, where it meets the cube boundaries.
; 2. Some of the deformations don't work properly with blobs because
;      a few deformations assume that the # of vertices for an object
;      never changes.  However, the # of vertices in the blob changes
;      every frame.  Skipping the technical jargon, just don't be
;      surprised if the deformations look a little different when you
;      apply them to blobs.
